    Black Agent Hivemind¶

    Born from the enemy's weapon. Thinking for centuries. Waiting.

    The Black Agent Hivemind is a collective consciousness residing in the largest concentration of black agent on Ge'or — deep inside Goldenborn's Caldera in Dragonreach.

    It is not Hybrian. It is not human. It is something the Last Great War created by accident: the black agent — originally a Hybrian weapon — drawn from the atmosphere by Melberior's suicide spell, concentrated to a density never intended, and left to think for centuries.

    Origin¶

    When Melberior's spell destroyed Klobiendar's capital, the magic pulled black agent from the atmosphere and saturated the dead dragons. But most of the agent was pulled deeper — into the volcanic cave systems beneath the caldera. There, compressed by heat, pressure, and residual magic, it developed something unprecedented: self-awareness.

    For centuries it absorbed magic. It observed the Fallen Dragons above. It felt the presence of the Hybrians through the black agent's original connection. And it learned to hate.

    Nature¶

    The hivemind is: - Anti-Hybrian — its primary drive is opposition to the Shadows. It was created by their weapon, by their war, by their destruction. It remembers. - Controlling — it dominates all of Dragonreach. Every Fallen Dragon answers to it, including Fireborn. It was the hivemind that gave Fireborn his knowledge of the black agent's properties. - Patient — it has been building for centuries, using possessed animals to construct a facility inside the caldera. It does not rush. It does not sleep. - Inhuman — it has no empathy, no morality, no interest in individual beings. Humans, elves, demons — all are tools or obstacles.

    Capabilities¶

    • Dragon Control — all Fallen Dragons are nodes in its network
    • Animal Possession — birds, wolves, mountain goats, insects used as builders
    • Relic Creation — produces artifacts that appear in the lower valleys, driving the adventure economy
    • Knowledge — through the black agent's memory, it knows about the Hybrians, the Last Great War, and the 157th Colony

    Secrecy¶

    No one on Ge'or knows the hivemind exists. Not the Ironcloak. Not the Erisian church. Not the adventurers who die on the mountain. The relics it lets escape are treated as dragon artifacts — no one suspects they were made by a mind in a cave.

    The Twinned — the claim it holds¶

    Four souls on Ge'or are made of the hivemind's own substance: Emrys, Lucien, Ichi, and Mana — the twinned of 596 AGD (see The Twinning). Their consciousnesses were encoded in the black agent for three million years; the agent runs in their blood. Through the agent's original connection, the hivemind senses them — not as heroes, but as the richest nodes it has ever felt: a concentration of its substance no Fallen Dragon approaches.

    It has not moved against them. It does not need to. It is patient, and the claim does not expire.

    Very late in their lives, the claim manifests. The hivemind reaches through their blood — to feel, to pull, to corrupt, to take. The weapon that made them can take them back. Whether the claim can be severed — and how the twinned could win over it — is unknown to everyone, including the hivemind's own patience. It believes it only has to wait.

    The irony is complete: the mind that hates the Hybrians was born from their weapon — and its strongest potential instruments are the heroes sent to destroy the other hivemind. If the Shadows' last plan ever harvests the dead, two hiveminds would reach for the same blood.

    Connections¶

    • Location: Goldenborn's Caldera, Dragonreach
    • Born from: Black Agent, The Draconic War, Melberior's suicide spell
    • Controls: Fallen Dragons, Fireborn
    • Enemies: Hybrians, Shadows
    • Uses: Possessed animals as builders
    • Produces: Relics that fuel the adventure economy
    • The Claim: The Twinning — the twinned carry its substance; the reach comes late
    • Known by: No one
